definitions.explanation: A garden or grounds designed for recreation and play. Rarely used on its own in modern Japanese; almost always appears as part of {遊園地|ゆうえんち} (amusement park).

examples.japanese: {遊園|ゆうえん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遊園|ゆうえん}⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A play space opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{遊園|ゆうえん}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A construction plan for a new amusement district was announced.

notes:
Bound form used in compounds rather than as a standalone word. The everyday word for an amusement park is ⟦{遊園地|ゆうえんち}→遊園地：03174_yuuenchi⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{遊園地|ゆうえんち}→遊園地：03174_yuuenchi⟧: amusement park
- {遊園|ゆうえん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: amusement facility
- {遊園|ゆうえん}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧: amusement district

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: park — general public park, not for rides or attractions
- ⟦テーマパーク→テーマパーク：28062_teemapaaku⟧: theme park — larger, themed entertainment complex
